entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A humanoid species with white, gray or blue skin and hair, whose males have sensory barbels on their chins; mostly nomadic and white-aligned.

entities.name: en-Kor
entities.description: Nomadic, deeply spiritual Kor of Rath whose religion centers on the sky.

entities.name: il-Kor
entities.description: Kor trapped in the shadow world between planes who served Volrath and often became thieves and spies.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: The event that brought the Kor to Dominaria.

entities.name: Mirri the Cursed
entities.description: In an alternate timeline, the Evincar of Rath who subjugated the en-Kor as her slave race.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Drew the Kor into Rath, where the il-Kor served him.

entities.name: Kor Haven
entities.description: The center of en-Kor culture, a city built into living rock.

entities.name: Skyclaves
entities.description: Flying citadels from which the ancient kor empire of Zendikar ruled.

entities.name: Smara
entities.description: A Zendikari kor, a witch vessel for a spirit trapped in a crystal, and a travel companion of Nissa Revane.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Plane where the Kor live nomadically and from which Rathi Kor originate.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: Plane into which Volrath drew the Kor and other peoples.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Final cause of fall of the ancient kor empire's citadels.

entities.name: world-gifts
entities.description: Kor children abandoned to the wilderness as sacrifices to pacify Zendikar's natural forces.

events.summary: With the Rathi Overlay the Kor are brought to Dominaria; the il-Kor are trapped between planes.
events.quote: With the Rathi Overlay , the Kor were brought to Dominaria .

events.summary: In an alternate timeline Mirri the Cursed subjugates the en-Kor as her slave race.
events.quote: subjugated the en -Kor as her personal slave race.

events.summary: Volrath draws the Kor into Rath along with other peoples.
events.quote: The Kor were drawn into Rath by Volrath like other peoples

events.summary: The ancient kor empire of Zendikar falls one by one to rebellions, civil wars and the Eldrazi.
events.quote: One by one they fell to rebellions, civil wars, and eventually the Eldrazi.

events.summary: In the Echoverse the kor empire never fell and still controls Zendikar from the Skyclaves.
events.quote: the kor empire never fell, and they still hold significant control over the plane from the Skyclaves.
